fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 6.0% on monthly gross revenue up to $83,300, 5.0% on revenue above $83,300; minimum is $500/month per territory for months 4-12, then $1,500/month per territory (no minimum first 3 months). Ad fund minimum may not exceed greater of 2% or $500/month; second franchise agreement minimum is $250/month. Tech fee $250/month for second and subsequent territories. All minimums may increase by CPI (royalty/ad) or 3% annually (tech).
raw_excerpt: Royalty: You must pay the greater of (a) 6.0% – 5.0% of your Gross Revenue for the immediately preceding month or (b) $500 per month per territory for the first year and $1,500 per month per territory thereafter. National Advertising Fund Payment: You must pay the greater of 1% of your Gross Revenue for the immediately preceding month or $500 for your first franchise agreement. Technology Fee: $500 per month for the first territory, $250 per month for second and subsequent territories.
